page.overview:
Who is Kevin?

Kevin is a unit and summonable vision in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. He is one of the six heroes in Trials of Mana and its 2020 remake. He is obtainable via the collaboration event with the Mana series.

The half-blood prince of the lycanthropic beastman tribe, Kevin is an exile from the southwestern kingdom of Ferolia. Kevin's father, the King of Ferolia, enters into an uneasy pact with the bizarre jester known as Goremand in order that he may further his plan for vengeance against humankind for their long history of beastman oppression. Goremand, however, has his sights on the eight Mana Stones that hold the world in balance. Kevin is tricked by Goremand into battling his howler pup friend Karl and killing him. In doing so, Kevin awakens his lupine powers and channels his anger directly at his father. After the fallout, Goremand leads Kevin to seek the Priest of Light in order to revive Karl. As with the other five heroes, Kevin is pulled into the greater struggle for the fate of the world's mana power.
